auth.forgotPassword_entries_with_welcoming_ms: Enter your email address to receive a reset link and regain access to your account.
auth.resetPassword_entries_with_welcoming_msg: Set strong new password to enhance security and protect your account.
auth.verifyEmail_entries_with_welcoming_msg: We've sent a verification link to your email address. Please check your inbox and click the link to verify your account.
auth.didNotReceiveVerificationEmail: Didn't receive the email? Check your spam folder or resend it.

invalid_credentials.title: Sign-in failed
invalid_credentials.message: The email or password is incorrect. Please check your details and try again.

user_disabled.title: Account disabled
user_disabled.message: This account has been disabled. Please contact support for assistance.

too_many_requests.title: Too many attempts
too_many_requests.message: Too many attempts have been made. Please wait a moment and try again.

network_request_failed.title: Connection error
network_request_failed.message: We couldn't connect to the server. Please check your internet connection and try again.

email_already_in_use.title: Email already registered
email_already_in_use.message: An account with this email already exists. Please sign in instead or try another email.

invalid_email.title: Invalid email
invalid_email.message: Please enter a valid email address.

email_not_verified.title: Email Not Verified
email_not_verified.message: Please verify your email address before signing in. Check your inbox for the verification email.

weak_password.title: Weak password
weak_password.message: Your password is too weak. Please choose a stronger password.

passwords_dont_match.title: Passwords don't match
passwords_dont_match.message: The passwords you entered do not match. Please try again.

permission_denied.title: Access Denied
permission_denied.message: You don't have permission to access this information.

unauthenticated.title: Authentication Required
unauthenticated.message: Please sign in again to continue.

not_found.title: Profile Not Found
not_found.message: We couldn't find your profile. Please try again.

invalid_argument.title: Invalid Information
invalid_argument.message: Some of the information provided is invalid. Please check it and try again.

failed_precondition.title: Unable to Complete Request
failed_precondition.message: We couldn't complete this request right now. Please try again.

unavailable.title: Service Unavailable
unavailable.message: We're having trouble connecting to the service. Please check your connection and try again.

resource_exhausted.title: Please Try Again Later
resource_exhausted.message: We've reached a temporary limit. Please try again later.

aborted.title: Request Interrupted
aborted.message: The request was interrupted. Please try again.

internal.title: Something Went Wrong
internal.message: Something went wrong while processing your request. Please try again.
